DIOH.prefLabel: Data on factors impacting on health, including socio-economic, environmental and behavioural determinants of health

EHCT.prefLabel: Data from clinical trials, clinical studies, clinical investigations and performance studies subject to Regulation (EU) No 536/2014, Regulation (EU) 2024/1938 of the European Parliament and of the Council34, Regulation (EU) 2017/745 and Regulation (EU) 2017/746

EINS.prefLabel: Health data from biobanks and associated databases

EMRD.prefLabel: Other health data from medical devices

HGPD.prefLabel: Human genetic, epigenomic and genomic data

HPML.prefLabel: Other human molecular data such as proteomic, transcriptomic, metabolomic, lipidomic and other omic data

HRAD.prefLabel: Healthcare-related administrative data, including on dispensations, reimbursement claims and reimbursements

IDHP.prefLabel: Data on professional status, and on the specialisation and institution of health professionals involved in the treatment of a natural person

MRMR.prefLabel: Data from medical registries and mortality registries

NRPE.prefLabel: Aggregated data on healthcare needs, resources allocated to healthcare, the provision of and access to healthcare, healthcare expenditure and financing

PGEH.prefLabel: Personal electronic health data automatically generated through medical devices

PHDR.prefLabel: Data from population-based health data registries such as public health registries

RMMD.prefLabel: Data from registries for medicinal products and medical devices

RPDG.prefLabel: Data on pathogens that impact human health

RQSH.prefLabel: Data from research cohorts, questionnaires and surveys related to health, after the first publication of the related results
